content.overview: Section 2(55) defines member as a subscriber, a person who agrees in writing and is entered in the register, or a person holding shares whose name is entered as beneficial owner in the depository records.
content.glance: Section 2(55) defines member as a subscriber, a person who agrees in writing and is entered in the register, or a person holding shares whose name is entered as beneficial owner in the depository records.
content.study: Entry in the register of members under s. 88, or the depository record, is central. Subscribers are members even before entry. Transfer does not make the transferee a member until registration. Minimum membership and the s. 3A consequence of falling below it should be kept distinct from the definition.

caseLaw.point: A share is the interest of a member in the company, measured by a sum of money and made up of the rights in the contract contained in the articles.
